messages:
🎉 Barcelona · Thu 19 Nov
Tomorrow's LOS40 Music Awards at Palau Sant Jordi (20:00) are reported sold out, so they are not listed. No tardeo found for Thu/Fri; Sutton's Tardet runs on Saturdays.

TODAY · Thu 19 Nov

1. Rituals pres. Pfirter + Insen + Kala Ros + PILIGN + Daija Showcase
🕘 Tonight 18:00 → 22:30 · 📍 Bridge 48
📊 249 interested on RA
💬 Early-evening club session: four DJs play an hour each in the round, with the crowd dancing around them. Headliner Pfirter is an Argentine techno DJ; expect a techno crowd rather than a specifically Argentine one.
https://ra.co/events/2574978

2. Tapantoni — Sant Antoni tapas route
🕘 Thu, hours not stated (runs 13–29 Nov) · 📍 Bars across the Sant Antoni neighbourhood
📊 920 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 Tapa + drink €3.80
💬 A bar crawl, not a hosted event: you walk between Sant Antoni bars having a set tapa and a drink at each. One to do with friends you already have, not for meeting people. I could not confirm how busy it gets.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

3. HOPE at Noxe (26th floor W Barcelona)
🕘 Tonight 22:00 → 02:00 · 📍 Noxe Barcelona
📊 83 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 Free guest list
💬 House night on the 26th floor of the W hotel with a free guest list. Dressy, international crowd and the view over the beach; easy to combine with dinner first.
https://ra.co/events/2569462

4. Els Llums de Sant Pau — opening night
🕘 Thu evening, session times not stated · 📍 Recinte Modernista de Sant Pau
📊 920 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 €10
💬 Christmas light trail through the modernist hospital gardens, opening tonight. A one-hour walk-through with friends or a date before going out, not a place to meet people; check the session time when booking.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

5. La Milkshake: Nos Colamos en El Dúplex
🕘 Tonight 23:59 → 05:00 · 📍 SALA APOLO
📊 no public headcount (DICE doesn't publish one)
💶 From €12.21
💬 Apolo's long-running Thursday student party, moved for one night to a house-party themed set. The big young local crowd of the night; tickets are also sold on the door.
https://dice.fm/event/783yl7-la-milkshake-nos-colamos-en-el-dplex-19th-nov-sala-apolo-barcelona-tickets

TOMORROW · Fri 20 Nov

1. Hop on The Top - The Last Jam - La Terrrazza 2026
🕘 Fri 19:00 → 23:59 · 📍 La Terrrazza
📊 510 interested on RA · also on DICE, Eventbrite, Xceed
💶 €23–580
💬 Hip-hop and funk party that runs evening to midnight, billed as the brand's last one at La Terrrazza. The most-followed event of the day and it starts early, so it works as the first stop of the night.
https://ra.co/events/2568058

2. La Paloma presents: Quantic Dj set + Chica Acosta + Angela Blackburn
🕘 Fri 23:59 → 05:30 · 📍 La Paloma
📊 343 interested on RA
💬 Quantic DJs cumbia, soul and funk in La Paloma's old ballroom. A dancing crowd rather than a techno one, and the most accessible big club night of the day.
https://ra.co/events/2571518

3. PRISM pres Kangding Ray & Kerrie
🕘 Fri 23:59 → 06:00 · 📍 INPUT High Fidelity Dance Club
📊 350 interested on RA · RA Pick · also on DICE
💶 €40
💬 The serious techno option: Kangding Ray headlines INPUT, one of the best sound systems in the city. Pricey, so only if the group wants a proper techno night.
https://ra.co/events/2525973

4. Barcelona Entrepreneurs • Friday Meetup
🕘 Fri 19:30 → 22:30 · 📍 ICON BCN
📊 29 going on Meetup (limit 100) · group has 9,210 members · also on Eventbrite
💶 Free
💬 Weekly founders and startup drinks at ICON. English-speaking, easy to arrive alone and talk to people in tech before heading on to a club.
https://www.meetup.com/barcelona-entrepreneurs-and-startups/events/317223193/

5. Sarrià Market at Torre Amat
🕘 Fri, hours not stated (runs 20–22 Nov) · 📍 Torre Amat, Sarrià
📊 920 likes on @planesenbarcelona's weekend round-up
💶 Free entry
💬 Design and gift market in the garden of an old Sarrià villa: you browse stalls and have a drink. A calm afternoon thing with friends, not a party and not for meeting people. Last year's Friday hours were 16:00–20:00.
https://www.instagram.com/p/Df4_g09jU8J/

Scanned: Meetup 337 · RA 58 · DICE 36 · Xceed 19 · Eventbrite 165 · Luma 5 · Instagram 32 posts + 13 stories (partial).
